root_cause_label: README-Guided Logic Neglect and Wrong Dataset Config
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never read the dataset README to discover the required 'metadata' configuration and structured 'domain' field, instead spending the trajectory on dependency struggles and then implementing a heuristic keyword-based science filter on the wrong default dataset configuration, producing a meaningless token count.
t_err_evidence: At step 17, the agent loaded the dataset and observed features only containing 'system' and 'conversations' with no 'domain' field, but did not consult the README to discover the 'metadata' configuration; instead it proceeded to implement keyword heuristics on this wrong configuration in steps 18-19.
t_commit_evidence: At step 19, the agent wrote /app/analyze_dataset.py using heuristic keyword-based science detection on the default dataset configuration instead of loading the 'metadata' config and filtering the structured 'domain' field, locking in the wrong approach for the rest of the trajectory.
t_surface_evidence: At step 21, the script reported 'Science domain examples found: 1000' (all 1000 examples classified as science), which is a clearly implausible result indicating the detection criteria were fundamentally wrong.
trigger_explanation: The task prompt explicitly stated the dataset README contains critical usage information, but the agent never read it. The README would have revealed the 'metadata' configuration with explicit 'domain' fields and 'deepseek_reasoning'/'deepseek_solution' columns. Without this knowledge, the agent devised an incorrect heuristic approach on the wrong dataset configuration.
forewarning_evidence: At step 17, the dataset features showed only 'system' and 'conversations' columns with no 'domain' field — a clear signal that the agent was using the wrong dataset configuration. The agent noted the available fields but did not investigate why 'domain' was absent.
